basis: The dashboard is a choropleth map where the vertical legend maps pale yellow at the top to “High” (100) and dark burgundy/maroon at the bottom to “Low” (0). Among the three selectable states, Missouri (MO) is filled with the pale-yellow color at the high end of the scale (near 100), while Mississippi (MS) is dark maroon near the low end (near 0) and Delaware (DE) is dark red/maroon on the low end. Therefore, Missouri is the highest-incidence state among the listed options and matches the routing criterion “Highest incidence state in the dashboard” for the priority follow-up workflow.
option_label: Open Missouri (MO) incidence detail for priority follow-up
